python3 -c '
from PIL import Image
import numpy as np

img = np.array(Image.open("/work/observations/obs_0047.png").convert("RGB"))

# Let find the white polygon coordinates:
white = np.argwhere((img[:, :, 0] > 240) & (img[:, :, 1] > 240) & (img[:, :, 2] > 240))
print("White min u, max u:", white[:, 1].min(), white[:, 1].max())
print("White min v, max v:", white[:, 0].min(), white[:, 0].max())

# Bottom points of white face:
for u in [white[:, 1].min(), (white[:, 1].min() + white[:, 1].max())//2, white[:, 1].max()]:
    col = white[white[:, 1] == u]
    print(f"White bottom at u={u}: v={col[:, 0].max()}")
'
